title: Mystic Plasma Orb
description: A glowing plasma globe with bright blue electrical arcs sits on a wooden table in a dark mystical setting. A translucent hand reaches toward the orb, which emits colorful energy streams connecting to glowing flowers, a luminous mushroom, and sparkling particles, while an open book and potion bottles rest on a shelf in the background.
prompt: A glowing plasma orb with bright blue electrical tendrils sits on a wooden table in a dark forest cabin at night. A ghostly hand reaches toward it, releasing colorful energy streams that connect to glowing purple flowers and a large luminous mushroom floating nearby. Sparkling particles and magical light fill the air. An open book and potion bottles sit on a shelf in the background. Mystical, ethereal fantasy atmosphere with vibrant neon colors.
